About the College
CNB College Bokakhat
C. N. B. College, Bokakhat, established in 1995, stands as a testament to the vision and collective initiative of the people of Bokakhat, who recognized the need for a dedicated institution of higher education in the region. Situated in the town of Bokakhat in the Golaghat district of Assam, the college campus spans approximately three acres and is equipped with the necessary infrastructure to create a conducive and enriching environment for academic pursuits.
Affiliated to Dibrugarh University, the college offers undergraduate programmes in science, with a clear and focused commitment to the advancement of scientific education. The academic structure is thoughtfully designed to nurture analytical thinking, innovation, and a scientific temperament among students, in alignment with the institution’s core objectives.
Read More
From principal's desk
Dr. Surajit Dutta
Principal, CNB College Bokakhat
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to CNB College, Bokakhat—an institution that has been steadfastly nurturing academic excellence since its establishment in 1995. Over the years, the college has evolved into a vibrant centre of learning, dedicated to providing a conducive and inspiring environment for quality education.
The year 2020 marked a significant milestone in our journey as we proudly celebrated our Silver Jubilee, commemorating 25 years of commitment to academic growth and institutional development. Throughout this period, the college has consistently strived to strengthen its infrastructure and enhance human resource development, aligning itself with the demands of contemporary scientific education. Today, CNB College stands as a well-equipped science institution, integrating modern approaches and facilities to support effective teaching and learning.
